text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in Amman on Saturday to consult with King Hussein on latest Midde East peace developments.
- Efforts being made to set up a society for thousands of unemployed graduates to lobby for their rights and seek job openings.
- New Jordanian ambassador to Belguim presents his credentials.
- Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti opens the first Jordanian cooperative conference on Saturday.
- Qatari minister of education praises the results of his visit to Jordan.
- Passports to be issued electronically by the Interior Ministry to prevent forgery.

- Jordanians have a significant share of some of the approved claims made under the U.N. compensation commission to compensate damages caused during Iraq's invasion and occupation of Kuwait from August 1990 to February 1991.
- Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy's visit to Jordan does little to narrow differences.
